clause_evidence.clause: Solve problems involving addition and subtraction
clause_evidence.reasoning: Every one of the twenty-three samples in this node requires learners to add and subtract quantities within realistic problem contexts. Problems range from addition-only scenarios to complex multi-step problems combining multiple additions and subtractions with clear sequencing of operations. Learners must identify which operation applies at each step and execute calculations correctly.

Every sample in this node contains either exactly three numbers or exactly four numbers as specified. The distribution includes eleven samples with three quantities and twelve samples with four quantities, providing balanced representation of both variants. No sample contains fewer than three or more than four numbers.

All quantities used across every sample fall within the specified range of up to two digits, meaning all operands are single-digit or two-digit numbers ranging from one to ninety-nine. No sample contains any number exceeding two digits, and values range appropriately including both one-digit and two-digit operands.

The competency explicitly includes money-based contexts as part of expected problem types. However, only thirteen of twenty-three samples present problems using Philippine currency, while ten samples use non-monetary contexts such as mangoes, storybooks, notebooks, or eggs. This represents approximately forty-three percent of samples lacking the money-based context specified in the competency requirement, indicating insufficient representation of this important variant.
